test_cases:
import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_bond_energy(2.2,0.2,96), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_bond_energy(0.5,1.5,64), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_bond_energy(80.0/0.34,0.05,48), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: zero anharmonicity, where the bond reduces to the purely quadratic one
assert np.allclose(dwlc_bond_energy(2.0,0.0,32), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_marginals(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_marginals(1.0,0.6,1.0,20,64), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_marginals(5.0,0.05,3.5,16,48), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: zero tension, where every row must be exactly uniform
assert np.allclose(dwlc_marginals(2.0,0.3,0.0,10,32), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_extension(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_extension(1.0,0.0,5.0,20,64), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_extension(0.5,0.9,1.0,20,64), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: a negative tension, where every projection changes sign
assert np.allclose(dwlc_extension(2.0,0.4,-1.0,14,48), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_closure_exponent(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96,16), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_closure_exponent(1.0,0.0,1.0,20,64,0), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_closure_exponent(0.5,1.2,-2.0,12,48,7), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: the last bond of the chain, where the backward weight is trivial
assert np.allclose(dwlc_closure_exponent(2.0,0.3,1.0,10,32,8), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_apparent_persistence(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96,16), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_apparent_persistence(1.0,0.8,1.0,20,64,3), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_apparent_persistence(3.0,0.05,-1.5,12,48,5), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: a harmonic bond, where every entry must return the input persistence length
assert np.allclose(dwlc_apparent_persistence(2.0,0.0,1.0,16,64,8), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_tangent_correlation(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96,16), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_tangent_correlation(5.0,0.0,0.0,32,96,0), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_tangent_correlation(1.0,0.7,1.5,20,64,13), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: the last segment as reference, where the forward branch is empty
assert np.allclose(dwlc_tangent_correlation(2.0,0.3,1.0,12,48,11), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_nematic_profile(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_nematic_profile(1.0,0.0,1.0,20,64), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_nematic_profile(0.5,1.1,3.0,16,48), target)

import numpy as np
# boundary: zero tension, where a uniform density gives exactly zero everywhere
assert np.allclose(dwlc_nematic_profile(2.0,0.4,0.0,10,32), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_audit(2.2,0.2,0.8,32,96), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_audit(1.0,0.6,1.0,20,64), target)

import numpy as np
assert np.allclose(dwlc_audit(0.5,1.0,2.5,16,48), target)

import numpy as np
